items.title: 11.4 Polar reagents ki taraf alkanes ki ghair-reactive nau'iyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.4, printed page 252.

blocks.text: Alkanes ko paraffins bhi kehte hain (Latin: parum = thora, affinis = lagao, yani ‘kam lagao’). Aam halaat mein alkanes acids, alkalis, oxidizing aur reducing agents ke saath react nahi karte (inert hain). Aam halaat mein alkanes ki is kam reactivity ki wajah un ke bonds ka non-polar hona hai. Carbon (2.5) aur hydrogen (2.1) ki electronegativity (electrons ko apni taraf kheenchne ki taqat) mein zyada farq nahi, is liye C–H aur C–C bonds ke electrons barabar share hote hain. Is se bonds taqreeban non-polar hote hain aur aam taur par react nahi karte.

Alkanes ke react na karne ki doosri wajah sigma bond ki mazbooti hai. Sigma bond mein electrons dono nuclei ke darmiyan bohat mazbooti se pakre hote hain, is liye yeh bohat stable (mazboot) bond hai. Is ko torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Hydrocarbons jalne (combustion) se CO₂ banti hai, jo greenhouse gas hai aur climate change (mausam ki tabdeeli) barhati hai. Adhoora jalna (incomplete combustion) carbon monoxide (CO) aur dhuein ke barik zarre (particulate matter) chhorta hai, jo sehat aur mahol ke liye bohat nuqsan-deh hain.

blocks.caption: Alkanes react kyun nahi karte

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke alkanes itne stable kyun hain (Quick Check 11.3a).
blocks.explanation: In ke tamam bonds mazboot, non-polar sigma bonds hain. In mein electrons se bhara koi hissa nahi jo electrophiles ko kheenche, aur koi polarity nahi jo nucleophiles ko kheenche. Is liye acids, alkalis aur oxidizing ya reducing agents aam temperature par in se react nahi karte.

items: Paraffins (‘kam lagao’): acids, alkalis, oxidizing aur reducing agents se react nahi karte, kyunke C–H aur C–C bonds non-polar hain (electronegativity 2.5 aur 2.1) aur sigma bonds mazboot hain.
